WEZLANA/WEZENLA has its own line from the 2025Q1 release; in the 2024 releases it is inside 'Other products'. Its first appearance in that footnote is the 2024Q1 release (the 2023Q4 release footnote lists RIABNI, AVSOLA, Corlanor, NEUPOGEN, IMLYGIC, Sensipar/Mimpara and BEKEMV only), so launch_quarter is 2024Q1 - an inference from the footnote and from the first non-nil prior-year figure, not a quoted launch date.
